subject.title: feat(gateway): durable cloud worker environments, provider SDK contract, and lifecycle RPCs

question: Should OpenClaw commit now to this cloud-worker configuration, plugin SDK, persistent-state, and gateway RPC contract as the public foundation for the remaining worker milestones?
rationale: The line-level defects are repairable, but automation cannot decide whether these long-lived public and security-sensitive contracts should ship before bootstrap, tunnel, worker protocol, and dispatch are proven.

options.title: Approve after repair and proof
options.body: Keep this architecture, fix all blockers, and require upgrade, security, restart, and live lifecycle evidence before merge.

options.title: Split internal and public surfaces
options.body: Land only internal lifecycle storage and defer exported plugin, config, and RPC contracts until later milestones validate them.

options.title: Defer the foundation
options.body: Pause this PR while keeping the parent design issue open for a later product decision.

recommendation.title: Approve after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Keep this architecture, fix all blockers, and require upgrade, security, restart, and live lifecycle evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the parent design, current assignment, and implementation series and is the best available decision owner for the public direction.
